videos.script: Seven divided by two is three in Java. Not three and a half. This lesson is about the places where arithmetic in a program parts company with arithmetic on paper. {{operators}} First the operators. Division between two whole numbers throws the fraction away. The remainder takes the sign of the left side. And the largest int plus one is a negative number, with no error at all. {{math}} Then the Math class: powers, roots, and three kinds of rounding that disagree below zero. {{floats}} Then floating point. Zero point one plus zero point two is not zero point three, and you will see the exact numbers that prove it. {{money}} Last, money. A double is the wrong place for a price, so the lesson shows the two right ones: BigDecimal, and a whole number of cents. By the end you know which type to reach for, and what each one will do to your numbers.
